description: Stage 1, SIMULATED pre-training: one rnn_lstm per Emerald (patch, basis), on a mixture of the team's calibrated models built from InfoRecord's Emerald package (calset 23e12f6b) with mlDecoder's readout-window extension, asymmetric readout and QND flips, plus the plain leakage model; R in the hardware set 1-20. Each model anneals over 540 s; four models stay under the 45-minute cap. Scored on frozen development sets against correlated MWPM, MWPM and uniform-weight correlated MWPM. Emerald's readout window, 1,036 ns, is computed from its pulse data (acquisition delay 460 + integration 500 + Garnet's 76 ns dead time; dq-orch-2), not compiled. The mixture leans on calibrated coherence and p=0.001 leakage: Emerald's real pilot (E1 Z R=3 eA) fires 0.138 detections per detector, against 0.144 for calibrated_coherence (Ramsey, asym, QND) and 0.207 for calibrated_leakage at p=0.003. The pilot summary chose the mixture only; it is never trained or evaluated on. Scope (Sal, 2026-10-25 ~00:00 UTC): proof of concept, the best patch only (eA), Z and X.
